migrations_applied.description: Removed RV1569 placeholder (D1): deleted version_id=2, CASCADE removed 31,102 verses, 66 books, 1189 chapters. Schema remains multi-version ready. Reduces DB from 15.19MB to 7.45MB.

Cross-references bíblicas (C1+C2+C3): added cross_referencia table with ~340k refs from openbible.info (CC-BY 4.0, via scrollmapper/bible_databases MIT). 4 triggers + 3 índices. DB grows from 7.45MB to ~34-35MB.
